title: Client-side or header redirect to computed address (java) — review required
description: A java redirect assigns a computed address: ["']redirect:. Untrusted input in the address turns the site into a phishing springboard. This lexical rule flags the assignment; the reviewer confirms the target is fixed or validated.
remediation: Allow only relative paths or listed hosts (a same-origin check) before redirecting.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any computed redirect target matches. Call-shaped redirects are separate rules.
